old_problem: The protected Master requires 500 Gen2-to-Gen5 changes, while the same-row DeepSeek command calls Speed Change 34 Gen3-to-Gen4. These exercise different initial states, rates and equalization paths.
disposition_reason: Neither ED-01 through ED-30 nor the source supplies an authoritative mapping from vendor label Speed Change 34 to one generation pair. Parameterization cannot select between contradictory coverage scopes, and executing both would invent extra coverage rather than reconcile the requirement. Preserve both claims and require owner/vendor disposition.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2109, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical conflict record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2110 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00031-V002 / 3d1c405fa59aa0f0 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Master Procedure explicitly states Gen2-to-Gen5; the matched DeepSeek command explicitly states Gen3-to-Gen4 for the same Speed Change 34 identity.
The pairs are not equivalent and cannot share a PASS result: they begin at different rates and target different equalization generations.
The numeric label and adjacent Speed Change rows are not authoritative and may not be used to infer or overwrite source semantics.
No command may run until the PCIe/NVIDIA owner identifies the versioned Speed Change 34 primitive, correct pair and governing specification.
After resolution, still require exact 500 atomic entries with proven start state, requested target, full width, LTSSM/equalization, error deltas, first-fault stop and recovery.
Do not clear evidence, automatically retry or accept a clean final link snapshot as reconciliation.
No LTSSM/NVQual, speed change, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: After authoritative scope resolution, prove five hundred full-width transitions for the exact Speed Change 34 source/target generation pair without disqualifying link or platform errors.
required_package: Signed vendor/owner disposition of Master Gen2-to-Gen5 versus DeepSeek Gen3-to-Gen4
Versioned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 34 package, command and configuration
Mapped PCIe path/lane topology with capability for the resolved pair
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT EXECUTE. BLOCKED pending signed source-conflict disposition. After the owner identifies the authoritative Speed Change 34 generation pair and pinned primitive, preserve baselines and execute exactly 500 fail-closed transactions for that pair, recording start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled target/width, enumeration, error deltas and health before each next cycle. Stop on first anomaly; do not clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Only after conflict resolution: all 500 chronological transactions prove the approved start and target generations at required width within the signed envelope, with required devices present and no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No verdict is possible while the generation pair conflicts. After signed resolution, PASS requires 500 complete accepted records for that exact scope; FAIL on scope mismatch, invalid start/target/width, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing disposition or artifact is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED while Gen2-to-Gen5 versus Gen3-to-Gen4 remains unresolved.
Do not derive scope from the label, neighboring rows or AI review.
After resolution use only approved tool/path and an isolated SUT with console and stable power/cooling.
Preserve first-fault evidence and stop without automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and both contradictory claims
Signed owner/vendor source-conflict disposition citing the governing Speed Change 34 specification
Pinned tool/configuration, resolved pair and complete path/lane capability map
Raw monotonic 1..500 records with correlated AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power evidence
First-fault/recovery or clean final state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Before resolution, perform no action. After resolution, inhibit later requests at the first wrong start/target, downtrain, endpoint loss, disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap; preserve the event, follow signed recovery, and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Protected Master says Gen2-to-Gen5 while matched DeepSeek command says Gen3-to-Gen4; no approved authority identifies which scope Speed Change 34 means.

blocked.reason: The review and required resolution are fully described, but execution is conditionally blocked by a specific owner/vendor decision rather than an unknowable safety condition.
